name: @atlasrepo/core
description: Open, local-first contracts and tooling for evidence-backed decisions.

scripts.test: npm run build --silent && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build --silent && node --experimental-test-coverage --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.schema:smoke: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js schema-smoke
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
